relation_to_current: Separate historical measurements; not current Native/A4 deployment comparison.
quality_filter: Historical technical-transfer admission only; all 204 pairs; no new 5% gate.
rank_ties: Spearman uses average ranks for exact score or FPS ties.
selection_ties: Static: frozen original_order (boundary order), then original pair order. Generic: original pair order.
random: Exact expected maximum of uniform k-subsets without replacement, combinatorial weights.
summary_population: Fixed nine classifier and twelve detector groups. k capped to group size. Every group equal weight.

score_formulas.weighted_score: minmax(log10(1+bytes)) + 3*minmax(imbalance) + 0.2*minmax(max(tensors-1,0)); full saved model universe normalization
score_formulas.onnx_real_boundary_hardware_aware: frozen Hailo10-to-TensorRT accelerator fit shared across setups; lower better
score_formulas.cycle_time_no_handover: stored heuristic total latency times max(left,right) compute share; lower better
score_formulas.stored_predicted_stream_fps: 1000/(stored bottleneck + stored handover term); higher better
score_formulas.measured_generic_completion: paired measured Generic completion FPS; higher better
